foreign_injury.open.title: {team_link} granted temporary foreign replacement slot
foreign_injury.open.title.v2: Injury opens temporary foreign exception for {team_link}
foreign_injury.open.body:
The KBO has approved a temporary foreign-player replacement slot for {team_link} because of {injured_player_link}'s injury. The remaining recovery window is listed at {days_left} days.

During that period, {team_link} may carry one additional {slot_label} foreign player. The approval is relief, not a permanent expansion. Once the original player returns, the club must move back inside the normal foreign-player limit.

foreign_injury.open.body.v2:
{team_link} has received a temporary foreign-player injury exception. With {injured_player_link} still {days_left} days from return, the KBO opened an extra slot for the club.

The club can use one additional {slot_label} foreign player during the injury period. The harder decision comes later, when the original player is healthy and the replacement can no longer fit through the temporary window.
foreign_injury.pending.title: {team_link} reaches decision point on foreign exception
foreign_injury.pending.title.v1: {team_link} reaches decision point on foreign exception
foreign_injury.pending.body:
{injured_player_link} is off the unavailable list, moving {team_link}'s temporary foreign-player exception into its decision stage. The injury basis for the extra slot is gone.

The club must now close the exception or make a standard foreign-player roster decision under the normal limit. The calculation that had been delayed is back on the front office desk.

foreign_injury.pending.body.v2:
The injury exception that gave {team_link} extra foreign-player flexibility no longer carries itself. {injured_player_link} has returned from the unavailable list.

Now the club has to choose: clear the temporary replacement or reshape the foreign-player group inside the normal KBO limit.
foreign_injury.closed_with_replacement.t: Original player returns, ending {team_link}'s extra slot
foreign_injury.closed_with_replacement.b:
{team_link}'s temporary foreign-player injury exception has closed. {injured_player_link} is back on the top roster, removing the basis for the extra slot.

{replacement_player_link} was cleared from the temporary replacement record. The club's foreign-player mix now returns to the standard KBO limit.
